# Veltorax
path in technology It solves the problem of confusion by providing structured roadmaps across fields like AI,Cybersecurity,and Web Development — from beginner to advanced levels.




<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1">
<title>Veltorax | فيلتورا</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#060912;--card:#0d1524;--neon:#3b82f6;--bright:#60a5fa;
  --accent:#06b6d4;--white:#eef2ff;--muted:#64748b;
  --bdr:rgba(59,130,246,.15);
  --font:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic",sans-serif;
  --mono:"Space Mono",monospace;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--white);font-family:var(--font);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.7}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button{font-family:var(--font);cursor:pointer}
a{font-family:var(--font)}
* {-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}

/* STARS */
#cv{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:.4}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(59,130,246,.03) 1px,transparent 1px),
  linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(59,130,246,.03) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:56px 56px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 5%;height:64px;
  background:rgba(6,9,18,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.logo-lnk{display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0}
.logo-img{height:42px;width:auto;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(59,130,246,.5));transition:filter .3s}
.logo-lnk:hover .logo-img{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(59,130,246,.9))}
.nav-ul{display:flex;gap:30px;list-style:none}
.nav-ul a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;transition:color .2s;position:relative;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale}
.nav-ul a::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-3px;right:0;
  width:0;height:1px;background:var(--neon);transition:width .28s}
.nav-ul a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.nav-ul a:hover::after{width:100%}
.ham{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:6px;
  background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.ham span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;
  background:var(--muted);border-radius:2px;transition:all .3s}
.ham.open span:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(45deg) translate(5px,5px)}
.ham.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.ham.open span:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(5px,-5px)}
.mnav{display:none;position:fixed;top:64px;left:0;right:0;
  background:rgba(6,9,18,.98);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  padding:10px 5%;flex-direction:column;z-index:99}
.mnav.open{display:flex}
.mnav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);transition:color .2s;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.mnav a:last-child{border:none}
.mnav a:hover{color:var(--white)}

/* HERO */
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;
  padding:100px 5% 60px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero-glow{position:absolute;width:700px;height:700px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(0,87,255,.12) 0%,transparent 68%);
  top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.25);
  border-radius:100px;padding:5px 18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--bright);margin-bottom:28px}
.bdot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;
  animation:pulse 2s infinite}
h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.8rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.18;margin-bottom:18px}
h1 em{font-style:normal;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bright),var(--accent));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.hero-p{font-size:clamp(.9rem,1.8vw,1.1rem);color:var(--muted);
  max-width:500px;margin-bottom:40px}

/* SEARCH */
.srch-wrap{width:100%;max-width:600px;position:relative;margin-bottom:28px}
.srch-wrap input{width:100%;background:rgba(13,21,36,.96);
  border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.3);border-radius:16px;
  padding:15px 22px 15px 52px;color:var(--white);
  font-family:var(--font);font-size:15px;outline:none;transition:all .3s}
.srch-wrap input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
.srch-wrap input:focus{border-color:var(--neon);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(59,130,246,.22)}
.srch-ico{position:absolute;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:20px;pointer-events:none;line-height:1}
.srch-x{position:absolute;left:46px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;background:none;border:none;
  cursor:pointer;display:none;line-height:1;padding:3px}
.srch-x.show{display:block}

/* PILLS */
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;justify-content:center}
.pill{background:rgba(13,21,36,.9);border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:100px;padding:7px 18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.pill:hover{color:var(--white);border-color:var(--neon);
  background:rgba(59,130,246,.08);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(59,130,246,.22);
  transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* STATS */
.stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:48px;padding:36px 5%;
  border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  background:rgba(13,21,36,.5);flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;z-index:1}
.stat{text-align:center}
.sn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--bright);display:block}
.sl{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}

/* SECTION */
.sec{padding:80px 5%;position:relative;z-index:1}
.slbl{text-align:center;color:var(--accent);font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;
  font-family:var(--mono)}
.sttl{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.4rem);
  font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
.ssub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;
  margin-bottom:52px;max-width:480px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}

/* SEARCH STATUS */
.srch-st{text-align:center;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:13px;
  color:var(--muted);min-height:20px}

/* SPECS GRID */
.specs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr));
  gap:20px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.scard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:18px;padding:28px 24px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.scard.hidden{display:none}
.scard-glow{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
.scard:hover{border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.5);transform:translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.scard:hover .scard-glow{opacity:1}
.scard-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:24px;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative}
.scard-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative}
.scard-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px;
  line-height:1.65;position:relative}
.scard-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  margin-bottom:18px;position:relative}
.scard-dots{display:flex;gap:5px}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%}
.scard-dur{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
.scard-btn{width:100%;background:transparent;
  border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.3);border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px;color:var(--bright);font-size:14px;text-align:center;
  transition:all .25s;position:relative}
.scard:hover .scard-btn{background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border-color:var(--neon)}

/* NO RESULTS */
.no-res{display:none;text-align:center;padding:70px 20px;grid-column:1/-1}
.no-res.show{display:block}
.no-res-ico{font-size:56px;margin-bottom:16px}
.no-res h3{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.no-res p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ═══ ROADMAP PAGE ═══ */
.rmpage{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);
  z-index:300;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.rmpage.open{display:block}
.rmpage-hd{position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(6,9,18,.96);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  padding:0 5%;height:60px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;z-index:10}
.btn-bk{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:8px;padding:7px 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.btn-bk:hover{color:var(--white);border-color:var(--neon)}
.rm-hd-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.rmpage-body{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 5%}
.rm-intro{text-align:center;margin-bottom:52px}
.rm-intro h2{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
.rm-intro p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}

/* PHASES GRID */
.phases-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.phase-col{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s}
.phase-col:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc,var(--neon)) 60%,transparent)}
.phase-head{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.phase-lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;
  color:var(--pc);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 12%,transparent);
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--pc) 28%,transparent)}
.phase-name{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.phase-list{list-style:none;padding:8px 0}

/* EACH ITEM ROW */
.pitem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:10px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  transition:background .18s}
.pitem:hover{background:rgba(59,130,246,.05)}
.pitem:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.pitem-ico{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;width:22px;text-align:center}
.pitem-txt{flex:1;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);
  line-height:1.4;transition:color .18s}
.pitem:hover .pitem-txt{color:var(--white)}
.pitem-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  background:rgba(220,38,38,.12);border:1px solid rgba(220,38,38,.3);
  border-radius:7px;padding:5px 10px;color:#f87171;font-size:11px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;
  font-family:var(--font)}
.pitem-btn:hover{background:rgba(220,38,38,.22);border-color:#ef4444;
  color:#fca5a5;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(220,38,38,.25)}
.pitem-btn svg{flex-shrink:0}

/* INTERNSHIPS */
.int-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));
  gap:20px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.icard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);
  border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;transition:all .3s;position:relative}
.icard:hover{border-color:rgba(59,130,246,.4);transform:translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.icard-bar{height:3px;width:100%}
.icard-inner{padding:22px}
.icard-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.icard-ico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.icard-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3}
.icard-co{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.icard-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.tg{font-size:10px;font-family:var(--mono);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px}
.tg-f{background:rgba(59,130,246,.12);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2);color:var(--bright)}
.tg-p{background:rgba(234,179,8,.1);border:1px solid rgba(234,179,8,.2);color:#facc15}
.tg-fr{background:rgba(34,197,94,.1);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.2);color:#4ade80}
.icard-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.65}
.icard-meta{display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px}
.icard-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.3);
  border-radius:8px;padding:7px 16px;color:var(--bright);font-size:12px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s}
.icard-btn:hover{background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border-color:var(--neon)}

/* FEATURES */
.feat-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:72px;
  align-items:center;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px 5%}
.feat-txt .slbl,.feat-txt .sttl,.feat-txt .ssub{text-align:right}
.feat-txt .ssub{margin-right:0;margin-left:0}
.flist{list-style:none;margin-top:26px}
.flist li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;
  padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.fic{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:9px;
  background:rgba(59,130,246,.12);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:16px}
.ftxt h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px}
.ftxt p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.code-box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}
.cbar{padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.cdo{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}
.cpre{padding:18px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;line-height:2.1}
.c1{color:#60a5fa}.c2{color:#86efac}.c3{color:#fde68a}.c4{color:#4a5568}
.pbars{padding:14px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.pbi{margin-bottom:12px}
.pbl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px}
.pbtr{height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.pbfl{height:100%;border-radius:4px}
.pf1{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22c55e,#86efac)}
.pf2{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0057ff,#06b6d4)}
.pf3{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c3aed,#a78bfa)}

/* CTA */
.cta{margin:0 5% 80px;border-radius:20px;padding:70px 5%;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,87,255,.12),rgba(6,182,212,.08));
  border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2);position:relative;z-index:1}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.3rem);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px}
.cta p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:30px}
.btn-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0057ff,#06b6d4);border:none;
  border-radius:12px;padding:14px 40px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,87,255,.35)}
.btn-cta:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,87,255,.5)}

/* FOOTER */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);padding:28px 5%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;position:relative;z-index:1}
footer p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.fl{display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fl a{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.fl a:hover{color:var(--white)}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}

/* RESPONSIVE */
html,body{max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .phases-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .feat-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;padding:60px 5%}
  .feat-txt .slbl,.feat-txt .sttl,.feat-txt .ssub{text-align:center}
  .feat-txt .ssub{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  html,body{overflow-x:hidden}
  nav{padding:0 4%;height:58px}
  nav .nav-ul{display:none}
  .ham{display:flex}
  .logo-img{height:36px}
  .hero{padding:88px 4% 48px;width:100%}
  h1{font-size:1.75rem;word-break:break-word}
  .hero-p{font-size:.9rem;padding:0 4px}
  .badge{font-size:11px;padding:4px 12px;max-width:100%;word-break:break-word;text-align:center;white-space:normal;line-height:1.5}
  .srch-wrap{padding:0 2px}
  .srch-wrap input{font-size:13px;padding:13px 16px 13px 44px;border-radius:12px}
  .pills{gap:7px;padding:0 2px}
  .pill{font-size:11px;padding:6px 12px}
  .stats{gap:18px;padding:24px 4%}
  .sn{font-size:1.4rem}
  .sl{font-size:12px}
  .sec{padding:56px 4%}
  .sttl{font-size:1.4rem}
  .ssub{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:36px}
  .specs-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
  .int-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
  .scard{padding:20px 16px;border-radius:14px}
  .scard-title{font-size:16px}
  .scard-desc{font-size:12px}
  .icard-inner{padding:18px}
  .cta{margin:0 4% 56px;padding:52px 4%;border-radius:16px}
  .cta h2{font-size:1.4rem}
  .cta p{font-size:13px}
  footer{padding:22px 4%;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
  .fl{gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .fl a{font-size:12px}
  .rmpage-body{padding:28px 4%}
  .rmpage-hd{padding:0 4%;height:54px}
  .rm-hd-title{font-size:13px}
  .btn-bk{font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px}
  .rm-intro h2{font-size:1.3rem}
  .rm-intro p{font-size:13px}
  .phase-head{padding:12px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
  .phase-name{font-size:13px}
  .pitem{padding:9px 14px;gap:8px}
  .pitem-ico{font-size:14px;width:18px}
  .pitem-txt{font-size:12px}
  .pitem-btn{padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px;gap:3px}
  .mnav a{font-size:15px;padding:12px 0;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
  .feat-wrap{padding:56px 4%}
  .code-box{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  h1{font-size:1.55rem}
  .badge{font-size:10px;padding:4px 10px}
  .pill{font-size:10px;padding:5px 10px}
  .srch-wrap input{font-size:12px}
  .scard{padding:16px 14px}
  .pitem-btn{font-size:9px;padding:3px 6px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="cv"></canvas>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <a href="#" class="logo-lnk">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Veltorax" class="logo-img">
  </a>
  <ul class="nav-ul">
    <li><a href="#specs">التخصصات</a></li>
    <li><a href="#roadmap-ex">المسارات</a></li>
    <li><a href="#intern">فرص تدريبية</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">عن المنصة</a></li>
  </ul>
  <button class="ham" id="ham" aria-label="القائمة">
    <span></span><span></span><span></span>
  </button>
</nav>
<div class="mnav" id="mnav">
  <a href="#specs" onclick="cn()">التخصصات</a>
  <a href="#roadmap-ex" onclick="cn()">المسارات</a>
  <a href="#intern" onclick="cn()">فرص تدريبية</a>

<script>
(function() {
  "use strict";

  /* ── STARS ── */
  var cv = document.getElementById('cv');
  var cx = cv.getContext('2d');
  var st = [];
  function rsz() { cv.width = innerWidth; cv.height = innerHeight; }
  function mkSt() {
    st = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      st.push({
        x: Math.random() * cv.width, y: Math.random() * cv.height,
        r: Math.random() * 1 + 0.2,
        o: Math.random() * 0.55 + 0.1,
        s: (Math.random() * 0.0004 + 0.0001) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1)
      });
    }
  }
  function drSt() {
    cx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
    for (var i = 0; i < st.length; i++) {
      var s = st[i];
      s.o += s.s;
      if (s.o > 0.8) s.s = -Math.abs(s.s);
      if (s.o < 0.08) s.s = Math.abs(s.s);
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,200,255,' + s.o + ')';
      cx.fill();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(drSt);
  }
  rsz(); mkSt(); drSt();
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { rsz(); mkSt(); });

  /* ── NAV ── */
  var ham = document.getElementById('ham');
  var mnav = document.getElementById('mnav');
  function cn() { ham.classList.remove('open'); mnav.classList.remove('open'); }
  window.cn = cn;
  ham.addEventListener('click', function() {
    ham.classList.toggle('open');
    mnav.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  var mlinks = mnav.querySelectorAll('a');
  for (var i = 0; i < mlinks.length; i++) {
    mlinks[i].addEventListener('click', cn);
  }

  /* ── SEARCH ── */
  var srchIn = document.getElementById('srch');
  var srchX = document.getElementById('srch-x');
  var srchSt = document.getElementById('srch-st');
  var noRes = document.getElementById('no-res');
  var noResTxt = document.getElementById('no-res-txt');

  function doSearch() {
    var q = srchIn.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    srchX.classList.toggle('show', q.length > 0);
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('#grid .scard');
    var vis = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
      var ds = (cards[i].getAttribute('data-search') || '').toLowerCase();
      var tt = ((cards[i].querySelector('.scard-title') || {}).textContent || '').toLowerCase();
      var td = ((cards[i].querySelector('.scard-desc') || {}).textContent || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!q || ds.indexOf(q) > -1 || tt.indexOf(q) > -1 || td.indexOf(q) > -1) {
        cards[i].classList.remove('hidden');
        vis++;
      } else {
        cards[i].classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }
    if (q.length > 0) {
      if (vis === 0) {
        noRes.classList.add('show');
        noResTxt.textContent = 'لم نجد نتائج للبحث عن "' + srchIn.value.trim() + '" — جرّب كلمة مختلفة';
        srchSt.textContent = 'لا توجد نتائج';
        srchSt.style.color = '#ef4444';
      } else {
        noRes.classList.remove('show');
        srchSt.textContent = 'تم العثور على ' + vis + ' تخصص' + (vis > 1 ? '' : '');
        srchSt.style.color = '#22c55e';
      }
    } else {
      noRes.classList.remove('show');
      srchSt.textContent = '';
      srchSt.style.color = '';
    }
  }

  srchIn.addEventListener('input', doSearch);
  srchX.addEventListener('click', function() {
    srchIn.value = '';
    doSearch();
    srchIn.focus();
  });

  /* ── BUILD & OPEN ROADMAP ── */
  function openRM(key) {
    var d = RM[key];
    if (!d) return;

    document.getElementById('rm-hd-title').textContent = d.icon + ' ' + d.title;
    document.getElementById('rm-main-title').textContent = d.icon + ' خارطة طريق ' + d.title;
    document.getElementById('rm-main-sub').textContent = d.sub;

    var grid = document.getElementById('rm-phases-grid');
    var html = '';
    for (var p = 0; p < d.phases.length; p++) {
      var ph = d.phases[p];
      var items = '';
      for (var ii = 0; ii < ph.items.length; ii++) {
        var it = ph.items[ii];
        items += '<li class="pitem">'
          + '<span class="pitem-ico">' + it.ico + '</span>'
          + '<span class="pitem-txt">' + it.txt + '</span>'
          + '<a class="pitem-btn" href="' + it.yt + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'
          + '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>'
          + 'شاهد</a>'
          + '</li>';
      }
      html += '<div class="phase-col" style="--pc:' + ph.color + '">'
        + '<div class="phase-head">'
        + '<span class="phase-lbl">' + ph.lbl + '</span>'
        + '<span class="phase-name">' + ph.name + '</span>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<ul class="phase-list">' + items + '</ul>'
        + '</div>';
    }
    grid.innerHTML = html;

    var rmpage = document.getElementById('rmpage');
    rmpage.classList.add('open');
    rmpage.scrollTop = 0;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  window.openRM = openRM;

  function closeRM() {
    document.getElementById('rmpage').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }
  document.getElementById('btn-bk').addEventListener('click', closeRM);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeRM();
  });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
